description_en: Obtains the URL for downloading an agent
name: GetAgentDownloadUrlV2

parameters.help_en:
The agent type.\
Valid values:

JavaAgent
Instgo
parameters.help_zh:
需要获取的 Agent 类型。
枚举值： JavaAgent Instgo
parameters.name: agent_type

parameters.help_en:
The operating system of the environment where the agent is installed.\
This parameter is required and valid only when AgentType is set to Instgo.\
Valid values:

linux
darwin
windows
parameters.help_zh:
表示 Agent 工作环境的操作系统类型。
仅当 AgentType 为 Instgo 时，该参数有效，且为必填。
枚举值： linux darwin windows
parameters.name: os_type

parameters.help_en:
The architecture type of the environment where the agent is installed.\
This parameter is required and valid only when AgentType is set to Instgo.\
Valid values:

amd64
arm64
parameters.help_zh:
表示 Agent 工作环境的架构类型。
仅当 AgentType 为 Instgo 时，该参数有效，且为必填。
枚举值： amd64 arm64
parameters.name: arch_type

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code.\
Valid values:

2xx: The request was successful.
3xx: The request was redirected.
4xx: The request was invalid.
5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态码。
枚举值： 2xx：成功。 3xx：重定向。 4xx：请求错误。 5xx：服务器错误

Data.description_en: The version number and download URL of the agent
Data.description_zh: Agent 的版本号及下载 Url

Url.description_en: The download URL of the agent

Version.description_en: The version number of the agent

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful.\
Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
查询是否成功。
枚举值： true：成功。 false：失败
